en: The image shows an old, black-and-white postcard divided into two sections. The top section depicts a rural street scene with wooden houses, a dirt road, and a building labeled 'Bedehuset' (meaning 'the prayer house' in Norwegian). The lower section shows a broader view of a small rural settlement, with several houses, fences, and fields partially covered with snow. The text 'Parti fra Brumunddalen' is visible, indicating a view from Brumunddal.
